Transport Documents

Declaración de Importación

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Declaración de Importación?

In this glossary, Declaración de Importación refers to: A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

How is Declaración de Importación used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "El importador completó la declaración de importación electrónicamente antes de que las mercancías llegaran a la frontera nacional para el despacho de aduanas."

Why does Declaración de Importación matter in logistics?

Declaración de Importación matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Declaración de Importación?

Declaración de Importación is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Declaración de Importación belong to?

In this glossary, Declaración de Importación is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Operational example

The importer completed the import declaration electronically before the goods arrived at the national border for customs clearance.

Localized term

Declaración de Importación

Localized example

El importador completó la declaración de importación electrónicamente antes de que las mercancías llegaran a la frontera nacional para el despacho de aduanas.
